fiche: Un sanglier têtu dont la peau durcit en plaques de fer, qui fouille les sous-bois et les prairies à la recherche de racines.
apparence: Stocky boar body with bristly fur and riveted iron-like hide plates, flat snout, curved tusks; dominant colors rust brown, ochre, dark gray.

stades.bebe: A round striped piglet ball with stubby legs, a pink flat snout and huge shiny eyes.
stades.enfant: Short tusk nubs sprout and a first small gray plate appears on its forehead.
stades.ado: Body lengthens, a bristly mane runs down the spine and iron plates cover the shoulders.
stades.adulte: A heavy boar fully armored in overlapping rusty plates, with long hooked tusks and a spiked ridge along its back.
stades.ancien: Massive grizzled boar with a white bristly beard, chipped tusks capped with bronze rings and moss growing in the seams of its armor.

fiche: Une chauve-souris aux crocs démesurés qui niche par colonies dans les grottes, les cryptes et les canyons.
apparence: Small furry bat creature with leathery wings, oversized ears and prominent fangs; dominant colors dusty gray, ochre, bone white.

stades.bebe: A fluffy gray fur ball with two giant ears, tiny wing stubs and big round eyes.
stades.enfant: Small leathery wings unfold and two little white fangs poke out of its mouth.
stades.ado: Wings grow wider with a hooked claw at each tip and the fangs reach its chin.
stades.adulte: A sleek bat with broad tattered wings, a bony crest between its ears and long saber-like fangs.
stades.ancien: Elder bat with silver-tipped fur, a scarred wing membrane mended with stitches and fangs adorned with tiny bone charms.

fiche: Une taupe fouisseuse aux griffes de pierre qui creuse des galeries sous les déserts et les montagnes.
apparence: Low, elongated mole body with velvety fur, enormous shovel claws made of stone, pointed nose; dominant colors sandy ochre, brown, slate gray.

stades.bebe: A plump velvet bean with a pink star-shaped nose, tiny paws and big sleepy eyes.
stades.enfant: Its front paws widen into small gray stone shovels.
stades.ado: Body stretches long and low, stone plates appear on its back like a pebbled shell.
stades.adulte: A long crawling digger with huge rocky claws, a drill-like horned nose and a back covered in jagged stones.
stades.ancien: Ancient mole with a long white whisker beard, crystal veins in its stone claws and tiny glasses-like lenses of quartz over its eyes.

fiche: Un loup cuirassé de plaques d'acier naturel qui chasse en meute dans la toundra et les forêts enneigées.
apparence: Lean wolf body with thick fur and natural steel-like armor plates on the head, shoulders and tail; dominant colors steel gray, brown, bone white.

stades.bebe: A chubby gray puppy with floppy ears, an oversized head and big bright eyes.
stades.enfant: A small shiny plate forms on its forehead and its ears stand pointed.
stades.ado: Long legs, a thick neck ruff, and steel plates spreading over the shoulders and along the tail.
stades.adulte: A powerful wolf wearing a full steel helmet-like skull plate, armored flanks and a bladed tail tip.
stades.ancien: Grand old wolf with a snowy beard-like ruff, dented and polished armor and a halo of frost breath around its muzzle.

fiche: Une hyène charognarde qui ricane la nuit en rongeant les os des ossuaires et des déserts.
apparence: Hunched hyena body with sloped back, spotted coarse fur and bone growths; dominant colors ochre, dark brown, bone white.

stades.bebe: A round spotted pup with huge round ears, a goofy grin and big eyes.
stades.enfant: Its front legs grow longer than the back ones and a tiny bone nub appears on its nose.
stades.ado: A spiky mane rises along the sloped back and bone spurs poke out of its elbows.
stades.adulte: A hulking hyena with a bone mask fused to its face, massive jaws and a row of rib-like spikes on its back.
stades.ancien: Elder hyena with a gray grizzled mane, a cracked bone mask hung with trinkets and a necklace of old teeth.

fiche: Un long furet-serpent au pelage soyeux qui se faufile dans les jungles et les marais pour voler des œufs.
apparence: Very long weasel-like serpentine body covered in sleek fur, short legs and a fluffy tail; dominant colors chestnut brown, cream, gray.

stades.bebe: A short fluffy sausage with a cream belly, a tiny pointed face and big black eyes, no legs yet.
stades.enfant: Four tiny paws appear and its body doubles in length.
stades.ado: The body becomes long and wavy with a striped back and a bushy tail tip shaped like a brush.
stades.adulte: A huge coiling fur serpent with small clawed legs, a bony ridge down its spine and a tail ending in a bone club.
stades.ancien: Elder serpent with long silky silver fur, wise whiskers like a mustache and a tail wrapped in ancient leather bands.

fiche: Un grand félin aux cornes recourbées qui guette ses proies du haut des falaises et des canyons.
apparence: Muscular big cat body with short fur, curved ram-like horns and a long tail; dominant colors golden ochre, dark brown, bone white.

stades.bebe: A round fuzzy kitten with oversized paws, a tiny tail and huge amber eyes.
stades.enfant: Two little horn buds sprout above its ears and faint stripes appear.
stades.ado: Long legs, a lean body and horns that start to curl backward.
stades.adulte: A powerful horned panther with spiraling horns, bony knuckle spikes and a tail tipped with a bone blade.
stades.ancien: Majestic old cat with a gray mane, horns engraved with runes and carved rings, and scars across its muzzle.

fiche: Un blaireau à six pattes griffues qui creuse ses terriers dans les forêts sombres et les champignonnières.
apparence: Low, wide badger body with six clawed legs, coarse striped fur and a bony back plate; dominant colors black, gray, bone white.

stades.bebe: A round black-and-white furball with a striped face, four stubby paws and big eyes.
stades.enfant: A third pair of tiny legs appears in the middle of its body.
stades.ado: Body widens and flattens, all six legs grow long hooked claws and a bony plate forms on its back.
stades.adulte: A wide armored badger running on six heavy clawed legs, with a ridged bone shell and a snarling striped face.
stades.ancien: Grizzled elder badger with a white beard, a cracked bone shell overgrown with mushrooms and worn golden claws.

fiche: Un grand singe qui se façonne une armure avec les os de ses proies et règne sur les jungles et les ruines.
apparence: Upright ape body with long arms, shaggy fur and bone armor pieces fused to the skin; dominant colors dark brown, ochre, bone white.

stades.bebe: A round fuzzy baby monkey with a big head, a tiny curled tail and huge eyes.
stades.enfant: Its arms grow longer than its legs and a small bone ring appears on each wrist.
stades.ado: It stands upright, with a broad chest, a shaggy mane and bone plates on its forearms.
stades.adulte: A towering ape with massive arms, a bone helmet with tusks, bone shoulder guards and huge knuckles.
stades.ancien: Ancient silver-backed ape with a long white beard, a cracked bone crown and a staff carved from a giant femur.

fiche: Un tatou blindé qui se roule en boule pour dévaler les dunes et les pentes des volcans.
apparence: Armadillo body with banded shell plates like a tank, short legs and a pointed snout; dominant colors ochre, slate gray, rust brown.

stades.bebe: A small round shell ball with a pink pointy snout, tiny feet and big eyes.
stades.enfant: Its shell splits into three neat bands and a small horn appears on its nose.
stades.ado: The shell grows more bands with spiky edges and its tail becomes armored.
stades.adulte: A heavy armored beast with thick riveted bands, a spiked back, a horned snout and a mace-like tail.
stades.ancien: Elder armadillo with a weathered shell covered in sand-carved patterns, a white whiskered snout and a glowing amber stone on its brow.

fiche: Un hibou-lynx nocturne aux serres immenses qui fond en silence sur ses proies dans la brume des forêts.
apparence: Owl head on a lynx-like feline body with large feathered wings and talons; dominant colors brown, gray, bone white.

stades.bebe: A round fluffy owlet ball with enormous round eyes, a tiny beak and kitten paws.
stades.enfant: Small feathered wings and tufted lynx ears appear.
stades.ado: Its body lengthens like a cat, wings grow broad and feathered, and the front paws become talons.
stades.adulte: A great winged owl-cat with a sharp hooked beak, huge sickle talons and a bony mask around its eyes.
stades.ancien: Ancient owl-beast with silver feathers, a beard of long plumes, and a rune-carved bone mask glowing faintly.

fiche: Un ours géant au dos couvert de roches qui se dresse sur ses pattes arrière pour défendre sa montagne.
apparence: Huge bear body able to stand upright, thick fur and boulders growing from its back and shoulders; dominant colors brown, slate gray, ochre.

stades.bebe: A round teddy-like cub with a tiny pebble on its back, round ears and big eyes.
stades.enfant: The pebble becomes a row of small stones along its spine and its claws darken.
stades.ado: It starts walking upright, its shoulders swell with rocky lumps and its claws turn stony.
stades.adulte: A colossal standing bear with a mountain-like ridge of boulders on its back, granite forearms and huge claws.
stades.ancien: Ancient bear with snowy fur, moss and small pine trees growing on its stone back, and a necklace of carved rocks.

fiche: Une chimère à trois têtes de lion, de bouc et de chacal qui rôde dans les ruines arcaniques et les canyons.
apparence: Chimera with a lion body, three heads (lion, goat, jackal) and a long tail ending in a bony spike; dominant colors ochre, brown, gray.

stades.bebe: A round cub with one cute face, two tiny bumps on its shoulders and big eyes.
stades.enfant: The shoulder bumps become two small extra heads, a baby goat and a baby jackal.
stades.ado: All three heads grow with their own features: goat horns, jackal ears, and a budding lion mane.
stades.adulte: A fearsome three-headed beast with a full lion mane, curved goat horns, a snarling jackal head and a spiked bone tail.
stades.ancien: Elder chimera with graying manes, the goat head wearing a long beard, scarred horns and bone rings on its tail.

fiche: Un mammouth colossal aux défenses de pierre qui migre lentement à travers la toundra et les glaciers.
apparence: Colossal mammoth body with long shaggy fur, curved stone tusks and a bony armored forehead; dominant colors dark brown, ochre, bone white.

stades.bebe: A round woolly calf with a tiny trunk, floppy ears and big eyes.
stades.enfant: Two small tusk tips appear and its fur grows long and shaggy.
stades.ado: Long curving tusks, a high domed head and a hump of thick fur on its shoulders.
stades.adulte: A gigantic mammoth with massive spiraling stone tusks, a bone armor plate on its brow and pillar-like legs.
stades.ancien: Ancient mammoth with frost-white fur, cracked tusks bound with ropes and relics, and snow piled on its back.

fiche: Le seigneur des bêtes, un fauve colossal couronné d'os dont le rugissement fait trembler toutes les terres sauvages.
apparence: Colossal beast-king with a lion-bear body, an enormous mane, bone antler crown and bone armor; dominant colors golden ochre, dark brown, bone white.

stades.bebe: A round fluffy cub with a tuft of mane on its head, big paws and huge golden eyes.
stades.enfant: A small bone circlet with three points forms on its forehead and its mane thickens.
stades.ado: A bear-like broad chest, a long flowing mane and antler-like bone branches growing from the crown.
stades.adulte: A colossal lion-bear king with a huge mane, a towering bone antler crown, bone shoulder plates and massive claws.
stades.ancien: Ancient beast-king with a silver mane like a long beard, a crown of antlers hung with relics, and a faint golden halo.
